name: Thalia Koulas
title: Founder and Peer Counsellor
description: Thalia works primarily with LGBTQIA+ and neurodivergent people, especially those navigating autism, ADHD, gender diversity, sexual diversity, and complex trauma. They're particularly passionate about working with neurodivergent trans and gender-diverse people, people that are bi, pan or asexual, cis/trans men, and the broader neurodivergent community. As a queer AuDHDer, Thalia brings a mix of lived experience and practical strategies, using a blend of Liberation Psychology, Internal Family Systems (IFS), Compassion-Focused Therapy, and Existential Therapy. Therapy Shmerapy (whose entire team is neurodivergent and trans/gender-diverse) lists among its focus areas 'alternate experiences of reality, thinking, or feeling - including psychosis, plurality, and dissociation'. Telehealth.
specialties: plurality, dissociation, LGBTQIA+, trans, gender diverse, autism, ADHD, complex trauma, IFS (parts), peer counselling, telehealth

name: Claire Munns
title: Lived Experience Practitioner
description: If you've ever been labelled as "too complex" or "too self-aware" for other services, then you're exactly the type of person I like to work with. I specialise in supporting people aged 16 to 45, with a strong focus on the Autistic, neurodivergent, non-binary, and queer communities. Lived and living experience includes ADHD, autism, BPD, chronic pain, LGBTQIA+ issues (gender, sexuality), self-harm and suicidal ideation. Therapy Shmerapy's focus areas include plurality and dissociation, and complex trauma. Telehealth; currently waitlisted.
specialties: non-binary, queer, LGBTQIA+, autism, ADHD, BPD, plurality, dissociation, trauma, peer support, telehealth

name: Avanthi Chrystine
title: Peer Counsellor
description: Peer Counsellor on Wurundjeri Woi Wurrung Country with lived and living experience of ADHD, anxiety, chronic pain, depression, disordered eating, LGBTQIA+ issues, occupational burnout, person of colour, self-harm and suicidal ideation. Therapy Shmerapy's focus areas include trans and gender-diverse support, plurality and dissociation, and complex trauma. Telehealth.
specialties: LGBTQIA+, neurodivergent, POC, plurality, dissociation, trauma, peer counselling
